topic: High power? Thinner lenses explained (lens index 1.50 / 1.56 / 1.60 Fusion)

youtube.title: Thick, heavy glasses? Which lens is thinnest? 👓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Thick, heavy glasses? Quick quiz: which lens is thinnest? 👓
தடிமனான கண்ணாடியா? மெல்லிய லென்ஸ் உண்டு!

• 1.50, 1.56 and 1.60 are lens index numbers.
• A higher index bends light more, so the lens can be thinner and lighter: 1.60 is the thinnest of these.
• Lenses for short sight are thickest at the edges; that's where a thinner lens helps most.
• Low power: 1.50 or 1.56. Higher power: 1.60. We'll guide you after your eye test.
